lines.text: Find the rating label, distinguish model from serial, and save the full identifier without moving heavy equipment or opening hazardous covers.

items.text: Read the brand from the actual appliance, not only a detached remote or accessory.
Use the manufacturer's model-locator instructions for that product type.
Open only ordinary user-access doors or lids that are safe under the manual.
Photograph the full plate and a readable close view, keeping all suffixes.
Copy model and serial into separate labeled fields.
Check likely confusions such as O and zero, I and one, or missing hyphens.

line.text: A what-to-buy line on each thing, printable as a single Item Card you can take to the counter.
